# Sergio Domínguez Pérez — Full-Stack Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Sergio Domínguez Pérez, a full-stack developer specializing in web and mobile applications. Bilingual site (English / Spanish). Built with Astro, React, Tailwind CSS, and deployed on Vercel.

## Main Pages

- [Home (English)](https://sergiodominguez.vercel.app/en/): Hero, tech stack, professional experience, featured projects, and GitHub activity.
- [Home (Español)](https://sergiodominguez.vercel.app/es/): Versión en español de la portada.
- [Experience / Experiencia](https://sergiodominguez.vercel.app/en/experience): Professional background and work history.
- [Projects / Proyectos](https://sergiodominguez.vercel.app/en/projects): Featured portfolio projects.
- [Web Projects](https://sergiodominguez.vercel.app/en/projects/web): Web application projects.
- [Mobile Projects](https://sergiodominguez.vercel.app/en/projects/mobile): Mobile application projects.
- [Backend Projects](https://sergiodominguez.vercel.app/en/projects/backend): Backend / API projects.
- [Contact / Contacto](https://sergiodominguez.vercel.app/en/contact): Contact form and details.
